import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)


# Preprocessing: strip quotes, normalize whitespace, lowercase
def clean_comment(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text.strip('"').strip().lower()
    return ""


train_df["clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test_df["clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Stratified train/validation split
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["Insult"]
)
X_train, y_train = train_df.loc[train_idx]["clean"], train_df.loc[train_idx]["Insult"]
X_val, y_val = train_df.loc[val_idx]["clean"], train_df.loc[val_idx]["Insult"]

# TF-IDF Feature Extraction
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train.values)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val.values)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["clean"].values)

# LightGBM Classifier
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_estimators": 300,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "min_child_samples": 5,
    "random_state": 42,
}
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Validation AUC
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Test Predictions
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Format Submission
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
target_col = (
    "Insult" if "Insult" in submission_df.columns else submission_df.columns[-1]
)
submission_df[target_col] = test_probs

# Ensure predictions are in the first column as instructed
cols_order = [target_col] + [c for c in submission_df.columns if c != target_col]
submission_df = submission_df[cols_order]
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
